metadata.title: Chuto Nath Dham of Santal Adivasis | 100 बकरा की बलि
metadata.description: There is a Shiva temple in Dumka's Chotunath Dham and the other is the Devasthan of the tribals. Santal tribals reach here in large numbers. People who come here come with many wishes. When someone's wish is fulfilled, that family or person would please Pahar Baba with sacrifice of a goat, Chicken or Pig.
